image_description: A low-resolution, warm-toned photograph of a group of people in what appears to be a costume party or club setting. The primary subject is a person in the foreground right wearing a voluminous, curly blonde wig and dark clothing. To their left is another person with short brown hair. In the background, a mannequin or person wears a reddish-pink wig. Several black balloons are visible in the lower foreground.

artifact_observations.location: Background mannequin and edges of foreground subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: Motion blur or focus issues combined with low resolution cause edge bleeding between the subjects and the background wall, particularly around the red wig in the back.

The black shapes in the bottom left are indistinct. It is unclear if they are balloons held by hands or just abstract dark shapes due to poor lighting and resolution. The anatomy of the hand holding them is lost in shadow and blur.
